video:video.video:title: When The Lord Came Down
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Genesis 11. Reflect on the tower of Babel in Genesis 11 and the difference between building a name for ourselves and trusting God.

video:video.video:title: One Meal Cost Him Everything
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Genesis 25. Esau’s birthright in Genesis 25 invites us to consider how today’s desires shape our choices and what we value most.

video:video.video:title: He Used God's Name to Cover a Lie
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Genesis 27. Jacob and Rebekah’s deception in Genesis 27 challenges us to trust God’s promises without trying to secure them through dishonesty.

video:video.video:title: Check Your Soil Today
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Genesis 37. Joseph’s brothers in Genesis 37 reveal how envy harms relationships. Reflect on gratitude, honesty, and love within the family.

video:video.video:title: Faith Sees God, Not Giants
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Numbers 14. The twelve spies saw the same land. Reflect on Numbers 13–14 and the courage to trust God when fear shapes the story.

video:video.video:title: Chosen, Yet Yearning for More
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Numbers 16. Korah’s rebellion in Numbers 16 invites reflection on pride, gratitude, and serving faithfully in the place God has given us.

video:video.video:title: Six Days And The Wall Still Stood
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Hebrews 11. The fall of Jericho in Joshua 6 encourages patient obedience and trust in God before we can see the outcome.

video:video.video:title: They Turned From God Many Times—Yet He Still Sent a Rescuer
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Judges 3. Read Judges 3 and reflect on Israel’s cry for help, God’s mercy, and the deliverance that calls His people back to Him.

video:video.video:title: The Answer Was Standing Beside Her
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Ruth 1. Walk with Naomi and Ruth through grief, loyal love, and unexpected provision. A devotion on finding hope when life feels empty.

video:video.video:title: Naomi Thought Her Story Was Over
video:video.video:description: A Bible story film on Ruth 1. Walk with Naomi and Ruth through grief, loyal love, and unexpected provision. A devotion on finding hope when life feels empty.

video:video.video:title: A Battle Fought Without Fighting Back
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on 1 Samuel 1. Hannah’s prayer in 1 Samuel 1 shows us how to bring deep anguish honestly to God and entrust our burdens to Him.

video:video.video:title: Are You Allowing God To Fulfill It?
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on 1 Samuel 16. David’s anointing in 1 Samuel 16 begins a long wait. Reflect on God’s timing, faithful service, and trust in unfinished seasons.

video:video.video:title: 400 Swords Came for Revenge - One Woman Stopped Them
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on 1 Samuel 25. Abigail’s courage in 1 Samuel 25 shows how wise words and humble action can interrupt anger and make room for peace.

video:video.video:title: Both Claimed the Child—One Wanted Him Alive
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on 1 Kings 3. Solomon asks for wisdom in 1 Kings 3. Reflect on listening to God, discerning what is right, and caring for the people entrusted to us.

video:video.video:title: He Stood Up to a King—Then Believed a Lie
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on 1 Kings 13. The man of God in 1 Kings 13 reminds us to test persuasive voices against what God has said and remain faithful to His Word.

video:video.video:title: Ahab Had a Kingdom - Yet He Was Miserable
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on 1 Kings 21. Ahab and Naboth’s vineyard in 1 Kings 21 expose the danger of coveting. Reflect on contentment, justice, and the desires we nurture.

video:video.video:title: Blessed Is The Hand That Gives
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on 2 Kings 4. The Shunammite woman’s hospitality in 2 Kings 4 invites us to practise thoughtful generosity and care without seeking recognition.

video:video.video:title: When Help Comes From the Unexpected
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on 2 Kings 5. Naaman’s encounter with God’s word in 2 Kings 5 invites us to lay down pride and receive grace with humble faith.

video:video.video:title: When The Count Is Against Us
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on 2 Kings 6. Elisha’s servant in 2 Kings 6 learns to see beyond fear. Reflect on prayer, God’s presence, and courage when you feel outnumbered.

video:video.video:title: A Death Sentence Reversed in the Courtyard
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on 2 Kings 20. Hezekiah turns to God in 2 Kings 20. Reflect on honest prayer, dependence, and bringing frightening news into God’s presence.

video:video.video:title: They Looked Alive… But Weren’t
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Ezekiel 37. Ezekiel 37 speaks hope into despair. Reflect on God’s Word, the life His Spirit gives, and renewal that we cannot create ourselves.

video:video.video:title: The Bones Came Together. Still No Breath. | Ezekiel 37
video:video.video:description: A Bible story film on Ezekiel 37. Ezekiel 37 speaks hope into despair. Reflect on God’s Word, the life His Spirit gives, and renewal that we cannot create ourselves.

video:video.video:title: They Chose The Furnace
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Daniel 3. The three men in Daniel 3 choose faithfulness in the furnace. Reflect on trusting God even when the outcome is uncertain.

video:video.video:title: His Only “Crime” Was Prayer
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Daniel 6. Daniel 6 reveals a life rooted in daily prayer. Reflect on faithful habits, courage, and trusting God under pressure.

video:video.video:title: Faith That Opened a Roof
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Mark 2. Four friends bring a paralysed man to Jesus in Mark 2. Reflect on persistent faith, forgiveness, and carrying one another’s burdens.

video:video.video:title: Has the Rooster Crowed in Your Life?
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Luke 22. Peter’s denial in Luke 22 invites honest reflection on failure, repentance, and the grace of Jesus that calls us back.

video:video.video:title: They Saw a Criminal—He Saw a King
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Luke 23. The dying man beside Jesus in Luke 23 turns to Him in faith. Reflect on mercy, salvation, and hope found in Christ.

video:video.video:title: When You Can’t See Jesus—But He’s Still There
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Luke 24. On the road to Emmaus in Luke 24, Jesus meets discouraged disciples. Reflect on Scripture, hope, and His presence in our confusion.

video:video.video:title: A Waiting Room Without A Doctor
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on John 5. Jesus meets a lonely man at Bethesda in John 5. Reflect on His compassion and the invitation to respond when hope feels distant.

video:video.video:title: He Demanded Proof. The Answer Had Wounds.
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on John 20. Jesus meets Thomas in John 20. Reflect on honest questions, the testimony of Scripture, and learning to trust the risen Christ.

video:video.video:title: A Life That Left Evidence
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Acts 9. Tabitha’s life in Acts 9 shows faith through practical kindness. Reflect on generosity, service, and the people our love reaches.

video:video.video:title: A Prison Break Nobody Took
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Acts 16. Paul and Silas pray and sing in Acts 16. Reflect on worship in suffering, faithful witness, and care for others in the dark.

video:video.video:title: Eager Hearts Search Scripture
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Acts 17. The Bereans in Acts 17 welcome the message and examine Scripture. Reflect on a faith that listens carefully and tests what it hears.

video:video.video:title: All Hope Was Gone - Then He Stood Up
video:video.video:description: A short Bible reflection on Acts 27. Paul’s voyage in Acts 27 offers encouragement for uncertain times: trust God’s promises and bring practical hope to the people beside you.
